 Honourable Sri Justice D.V.S.S. Somayajulu

entities.text: M.V Srinivasa Rao vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: This Criminal Petition is filed by the petitioners under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure to quash the proceedings against the petitioners, in FIR No.245 of 2019 on the file of Sub- Inspector of Police, II Town Police Station, Tenali, Guntur District.

entities.text: II Town Police Station, Tenali, Guntur District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
The offences alleged are under Sections 353, 188, 270, 273, 328 and 420 r/w 34 of Indian Penal Code, 1860 and under Sections 56,
57 (1) and 63 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

Heard Sri Raja Reddy Koneti, learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent-State.
Both the counsel agree that this matter is squarely covered by the judgment of the single Judge in the batch petitions bearing Criminal Petition Nos.3731 of 2018 and others.

As both the learned counsel agree nothing further survives for adjudication, further proceedings in FIR No.245 of 2019 on the file of Sub-Inspector of Police, II Town Police Station, Tenali, Guntur District for the offences under Sections 353, 188, 270, 273, 328 and 420 r/w 34 of Indian Penal Code, 1860 and under Sections 56, 57 (1) and 63 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, are hereby quashed.

entities.text: II Town Police Station, Tenali, Guntur District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: As a sequel, miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this criminal petition shall stand closed.
